road_plane_description: Approximate quadrilateral on the rightmost approaching lane beside the concrete median.

units.speed: km/h for display only (demo; not physically calibrated)

notes: DEMO ONLY. The road polygon is estimated visually from video4.mp4. The 3.6 m lane width and 20 m road length are assumptions, not measurements. Displayed km/h is the estimated m/s multiplied by 3.6; this conversion does not make the result physically accurate. The road curves and perspective varies, so verify the lane points and measure known distances before using this calibration for real-world speed.
